text:
sarah.c: Quick question — how should the console show cache-savings when a single request spans multiple model variants? e.g., prompt routed to llama-2-13B then falls back to gpt-j-6B. We need per-request breakdown in cost card. Thoughts? :thinking:
kevin.m: We currently attribute full request tokens to the first model that executed KV cache; fallback tokens get charged to fallback model. That double-counts prefetch. Maybe we should prorate by tokens per model?
raj.v: Prorate seems ok but will break current per-model revenue dashboards. Also, cache hits are tricky — a hit avoids regen cost, but attribution depends on cache ownership. We have cache owner tags in trace, can we use those?
eileen: From UX: keep the card simple. Show 'Total cost' + 'Cache savings (estimated)' with a tooltip that expands to per-model split. Users mostly care about net cost not the math.
kevin.m: Implementation note: we can add fields in econ telemetry: prefetch_tokens, regen_tokens, cache_hit_tokens, cache_owner_model. Example event: `tokens:{prefetch:300,regen:120,cache_hits:180}`. Then console can do calc. @sarah.c does that give you enough?
sarah.c: Yes, but need deterministic tie-break for prefetch: if prefetch warms multiple model variants, which one gets credit? Proposal: earliest writer wins, then amortize if shared. Preference: earliest writer -> owners get credit.
raj.v: Earliest writer works. For amortization we can emit `cache_credit_shares:["llama-2-13b:0.7","gpt-j-6b:0.3"]` in telemetry. But keep numbers small to avoid large ingest.
eileen: UI suggestion: show a micro-sparkline for cost delta if you toggle 'show per-model breakdown'. Keep default collapsed. Tooltip copy: 'Cache savings are estimated using telemetry; may be imprecise during rollouts.'
kevin.m: One more bikeshed: metric name for saved tokens — `saved_tokens` vs `cache_savings_tokens`. I prefer `saved_tokens` to be concise.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: new telemetry fields `saved_tokens`, `cache_owner`, `cache_credit_shares` added to staging. CI passed. /cc @kevin.m
sarah.c: Awesome. Can we get a quick spike to show mockups + a sample console card with numbers? I can show to pricing. Target: Monday.
kevin.m: I'll land a telemetry schema PR today and push a staging UI mock. ping me if pricing needs sample CSV.
